reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Configuration `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` is removed: The setting `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` (`-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup`) was a…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The configuration setting `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` is no longer recognized; any explicit configuration will be ignored and the previous default value `false` will be applied.
consequence.remediation: Remove the `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` setting (and `-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup` CLI flag) from your Loki configuration, as the TSDB index is now the stable and recommended type.

proposed.statement: The configuration setting `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` (CLI flag `-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup`) has been removed; environments that explicitly set it will have that setting ignored and the previous default value `false` applied.
